previous_statement: Second three-factor replacement. Assuming the same one-factor estimate with d:=2(C_theta+C_Delta)eta and complete contractivity, put P3:=Phi_n(Phi_n(Delta_n X Delta_n Y) Delta_n Z). A two-factor telescope inside the inner Phi_n costs at most 2d||X||||Y|| and replacing the last Phi_n(Delta_n Z) by Delta_n Z costs at most d||Z||, so ||P2-P3|| <= 3d||X||||Y||||Z||.
new_statement: Second three-factor replacement. Define P2:=Phi_n(Phi_n(Phi_n(Delta_n X) Phi_n(Delta_n Y)) Phi_n(Delta_n Z)) and P3:=Phi_n(Phi_n(Delta_n X Delta_n Y) Delta_n Z). Assuming ||Phi_n(Delta_n T)-Delta_n T|| <= d||T|| for all T, where d:=2(C_theta+C_Delta)eta, and complete contractivity of Phi and Delta, a two-factor telescope inside the inner Phi_n costs at most 2d||X||||Y|| and replacing the last Phi_n(Delta_n Z) by Delta_n Z costs at most d||Z||, so ||P2-P3|| <= 3d||X||||Y||||Z||.
